content.text:
Fixed. `ProjectFileGroupDialog.kt:239` now uses the replacement the deprecation javadoc points to.

The source you linked confirms **both** `SimpleListCellRenderer.create` overloads are `@Deprecated(forRemoval = true)` — so swapping to the `Customizer` overload (my first attempt) would have just traded one removal warning for another. The actual replacement is `com.intellij.ui.dsl.listCellRenderer.textListCellRenderer(nullValue, getText)`, which is a drop-in for the `create(String, Function)` shape and additionally supports rounded selection (the limitation the javadoc calls out).

Verified against the targeted platform: `textListCellRenderer` is present in `lib/intellij.platform.ide.jar` of Android Studio 2026.1.3.7, so it's available at `pluginSinceBuild = 261`.

```
./gradlew compileKotlin --rerun-tasks  →  BUILD SUCCESSFUL
```

The deprecation warning is gone. One unrelated pre-existing warning remains, untouched: `ProjectFileGroupNode.kt:23` shadows the Java field `myProject`.

```diff
+renderer = textListCellRenderer("") { it.name }
```

## Why

[`SimpleListCellRenderer`](https://github.com/JetBrains/intellij-community/blob/master/platform/platform-api/src/com/intellij/ui/SimpleListCellRenderer.java) has **both** its static `create` overloads marked `@Deprecated(forRemoval = true)` — so switching to the `Customizer` overload would only trade one removal warning for another. The javadoc points at `com.intellij.ui.dsl.listCellRenderer.textListCellRenderer`, which is a drop-in for the `create(String, Function)` shape and additionally supports rounded selection (the limitation the deprecation notes call out).

## Compatibility

`textListCellRenderer` is present in `lib/intellij.platform.ide.jar` of the targeted Android Studio 2026.1.3.7 distribution, so it is available at `pluginSinceBuild = 261`.

## Verification

`./gradlew compileKotlin --rerun-tasks` → `BUILD SUCCESSFUL`, deprecation warning gone. The one remaining warning (`ProjectFileGroupNode.kt:23` shadowing the Java `myProject` field) is pre-existing and untouched.
